title: Dense-open assertions for prime-torsion module coefficients
statement: Let k be algebraically closed and f:X → Spec k a reduced curve [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting]. Let Λ be a finite commutative coefficient ring, r prime, and F a constructible module-valued etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] satisfying r times its identity equals zero. For every dense open U of X, the eight conditional assertions [def-weil-pbc-eight-curve-assertions] for F are equivalent to those for extension by zero of its restriction to U [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. The statement uses the original ModuleCat Λ encoding and its original cohomology comparison maps.

proof.text: Let G be extension by zero of the restriction and ε:G -> F the forgotten canonical counit. Use dense_open_high_cohomology to obtain bijectivity of Sheaf.H.map ε in degrees greater than one and of its inverse image in degree two on each open immersion.
For each q>2 (respectively q>1 in the affine case), Equiv.ofBijective applied to Sheaf.H.map ε transfers Subsingleton in both directions. This proves the equivalences for C1 and C2.

Obtain the equivalences for C3, C4 and C5 from dense_open_primary_finiteness and those for C6 and C7 from dense_open_base_change. Each theorem has exactly the original conditional predicates and coefficient convention.

For every open immersion a:W -> X, cohomologyMap_map gives the commuting square of degree-two restriction maps with vertical arrows H^2(ε) and H^2(a^*ε). Both vertical maps are bijective. To transfer surjectivity from F to G, map a class on W with coefficients G into F, lift it on X, lift back through H^2(ε), and use injectivity of H^2(a^*ε) and commutativity. To transfer from G to F, lift a class on W through H^2(a^*ε), lift it by the restriction map for G, and map it through H^2(ε). The private square lemma formalizes these two arguments.
Rewrite both Assertions with assertions_iff, and combine the eight individual equivalences using Iff.and. No target or existing theorem signature changes.

lean.statement:
theorem assertions_iff_dense_open_prime (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f] [IsReduced X]
    (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime] (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    [Scheme.IsConstructibleSheaf F] (hF : r • 𝟙 F = 0)
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : Dense (U : Set X)) :
    IsCurve.Assertions Λ f F ↔ IsCurve.Assertions Λ f
      ((U.ι)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj ((U.ι)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F))
